title: Command Center demo red monitoring banner
description: Proves the demo-gated Farmslot monitoring banner is absent by default and present when the demo env flag is enabled on the slot sandbox. Use the slot sandbox Vite port (from pool .env.ports, typically 5876 on macwork-ff-*) — not the operator UI on 5174.

open-slot-shell.intent: Open the slot shell on the sandbox UI port.

assert-banner-absent.intent: Verify the demo banner is not visible when the demo flag is off.

capture-without-banner.note: Slot shell without demo banner — reviewer before state
capture-without-banner.intent: Record reviewer-visible proof that the shell renders without the demo banner.

restart-with-demo-flag.cmd: FARMSLOT_SLOT_REPO="{{params.repo}}" bash "{{params.farmslot_dir}}/projects/farmslot-farm/setup/sandbox-dev.sh" stop --gateway-port {{params.gateway_port}} && VITE_FARMSLOT_DEMO_BANNER=1 FARMSLOT_SLOT_REPO="{{params.repo}}" bash "{{params.farmslot_dir}}/projects/farmslot-farm/setup/sandbox-dev.sh" start --gateway-port {{params.gateway_port}}
restart-with-demo-flag.intent: Restart the sandbox dev stack with the demo banner env flag enabled.

open-slot-shell-demo-on.intent: Reload the slot shell after enabling the demo flag.

assert-banner-present.intent: Verify the exact demo banner copy is visible when the flag is on.

capture-with-banner.note: Red demo banner visible with exact monitoring copy
capture-with-banner.intent: Record reviewer-visible proof of the red demo monitoring banner.
